title: Repetitions Shown with Print Symbols

illustrates.quote: Represent a spaced dash, hyphen, or special print sign that is used to indicate the repetition of an entire word by a spaced braille dash.

braille.notes: Re-extracted from source: the given run's braille.lines wrongly included the 'Example 21-38: ...' title and 4 leading blank lines — removed; the remaining 3 real lines already had their margin correctly stripped.

uncertain: The glyph on line 2 ('der Laden, ¨—') is read as a dash with a diaeresis above it (¨—), per the review's round-2 question 3, not yet confirmed against the source image with certainty.
resolution: braille.lines corrected: removed 5 bogus leading lines (title + 4 blanks). braille.lines left unchanged by the 2026-09-25 print-description correction (below); only the print reading of line 2's repetition symbol was wrong.
